raw:
The experiments come in matched pairs. Within each pair the edit is the same, and the two parents differ mainly in the edge named in the condition. Mostly I target structural interactions:
- whether a path into the output is cut off;
- whether a node is left with no inputs;
- whether a residual (skip) edge sits alongside convolutions;
- what operation an edit replaces on the same edge.
